## Install

Run `dx init --apply` in the repository, as in the [Quickstart](../../README.md#quickstart).

For a AsciiDoc project it writes this `MODULE.bazel`, tested in [`asciidoc/tests/consumer`](../../asciidoc/tests/consumer/consumer.MODULE.bazel):

```python
# dx: yours; dx adds its missing lines
module(name = "my_project")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//asciidoc:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//asciidoc:defs.bzl", "asciidoc_library")
```
